fullDescription: Metric-led teal trust hero: a deep teal gradient hero (near-black teal dissolving into an off-white canvas) with a faint white grid overlay, a glassy 'New' eyebrow pill, an extrabold Inter headline 'Design production UI at the speed of a prompt', a dual CTA (solid teal + glassy watch-demo), an avatar-stack + 4.9-star trust signal, three overlapping white metric cards (2.4M / 9x / 12k+) with teal top-accent bars, and a six-logo trust strip. Phosphor icons, conversion-optimized SaaS landing hero.

structured.summary: A metric-led, trust-forward SaaS landing hero in a deep teal palette. A dark teal radial+linear gradient hero (ink #042f2e to canvas #f8fafc) with a faint white grid overlay carries a centered headline 'Design production UI at the speed of a prompt'. A glassy 'New' eyebrow pill, a teal subhead, a dual CTA (solid teal primary + glassy ghost 'watch demo'), a no-credit-card microcopy line, and an inline trust signal (avatar stack +9k and a 4.9 star rating) sit above the fold. A row of three white metric cards (2.4M / 9x / 12k+) overlaps the bottom edge of the hero, each with a teal top-accent bar and a soft elevated shadow. Below, a centered trust headline introduces a six-logo strip in a bordered white card. Inter throughout; Phosphor icons via Iconify.

style.description: Trust-forward SaaS marketing style built on a deep, premium teal gradient. The hero ground is near-black teal (#042f2e) blending up through teal mid-tones into the off-white canvas (#f8fafc) at the fold, lit by two soft radial teal glows and overlaid with a faint 56px white grid that is radial-masked so it fades toward the edges. Type is all Inter, very tight tracking, extrabold (800-900) for the headline and section heads, with teal-tinted white body copy at reduced opacity on dark and slate grays on light. Accent system is a single teal scale (workhorse #14b8a6 / #0d9488, deep grounds #042f2e / #134e4a, soft tints #99f6e4 / #ccfbf1 / #f0fdfa). Surfaces are glassy on the dark hero (translucent white fills, white-15% hairline borders, backdrop blur) and crisp white with slate-200 borders and soft teal-tinted drop shadows on the light section. Mood is confident, clean, conversion-optimized, premium; never flat or generic.
style.prompt: Design a trust-forward SaaS landing hero in a deep teal palette using Inter throughout (weights 400-900, tight -0.02em tracking; headline 800-900). Palette: hero ground near-black teal #042f2e blending up through #073735, #0e524d, #1d6b64, #3f8d85, #a9d8d1 into off-white canvas #f8fafc at the fold; teal accents #14b8a6 (primary), #0d9488 (deep primary), #0f766e / #115e59 / #134e4a (grounds), #99f6e4 / #ccfbf1 / #f0fdfa (soft tints), #2dd4bf (glow); text ink #0f172a, slate #334155, muted slate #64748b. Hero background = layered CSS: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 80% -12%, rgba(20,184,166,0.60), transparent 52%) + radial-gradient(95% 75% at 10% -4%, rgba(45,212,191,0.28), transparent 46%) over a vertical linear-gradient(180deg) running the teal-to-canvas stops above. Over it lay a faint white grid overlay (two 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05) line gradients at 56px, radial-masked from 50% 0% so it fades to transparent at ~72%). On the dark hero use glassy surfaces (bg white/10, border white/15-20, backdrop blur) and teal-tinted white text at 75-90% opacity; on the light section use white cards with slate-200/80 borders and soft teal-tinted shadows (e.g. 0 28px 64px -30px rgba(2,47,46,0.5)). Primary buttons are solid teal #14b8a6 with dark teal-950 text and a teal drop shadow that lifts on hover; ghost buttons are translucent white with a hairline border and blur. Use Phosphor (ph:*) icons via Iconify. Keep it confident, premium and conversion-optimized.

layout_and_structure.description: Single-column centered landing flow, content capped at max-w-6xl (nav, hero text, trust section) and max-w-5xl for the overlapping stat row, with px-6 gutters. Top-down: a sticky blurred nav bar (64px, dark teal translucent) with logo + center links + sign-in/start-free buttons; a tall centered hero section (deep teal gradient + grid overlay) holding an eyebrow pill, headline, subhead, dual CTA, microcopy and an inline avatar+rating trust signal, with generous bottom padding; a three-up white metric-card row pulled up with negative margin so it overlaps the bottom of the hero; and a centered trust section (heading + subcopy) above a bordered white card containing a responsive six-logo strip. Responsive: nav center links hide below md and the sign-in button below sm; the headline drops from 6xl to 42px and removes its forced line break on small screens; the CTA stack goes column on mobile, row on sm+; the stat row goes 1 col to 3 cols at sm; the logo strip goes 2 cols to 3 cols at sm to 6 cols at lg.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent dark-teal background (teal-950 #042f2e at ~70%), a backdrop blur+saturate, and a white-10% bottom hairline border. Inside a max-w-6xl row, height 64px: left = a rounded-lg gradient logo mark (linear-gradient(135deg,#14b8a6,#0f766e)) with a teal shadow holding a white Phosphor ph:squares-four-fill icon, beside an extrabold white 'Mosaic' wordmark; center = medium-weight teal-100/80 nav links (Library, Features, Pricing, Docs) that brighten to white on hover, hidden below md; right = a 'Sign in' ghost button (teal-50 text, white-15 hairline border, hover white/10 fill, hidden below sm) and a solid 'Start free' button (teal-200 #99f6e4 fill, teal-950 text, hover to white).

A tall centered hero section over the deep teal gradient (hero-grad) with the faint white grid overlay layered on top (pointer-events none). Content centered in max-w-6xl, pt-20 with large bottom padding (pb-40 / sm:pb-48) so the stat row can overlap it. Stack: (1) an eyebrow pill: an inline-flex glassy rounded-full chip (bg white/10, white/15 border, backdrop blur) containing a small bold uppercase teal-400/90 'New' badge with teal-950 text, next to a medium teal-50/90 label 'Prompt-to-UI on an infinite canvas'; (2) an extrabold white headline 'Design production UI
at the speed of a prompt' at text 42px to sm:text-6xl, leading ~1.03, tight tracking, max-w-4xl, with the line break hidden below sm; (3) a teal-50/80 subhead paragraph (max-w-2xl, ~16.5-18px) 'Mosaic turns a sentence into mockups, components, and full flows. Start from a battle-tested prompt, iterate on canvas, and hand engineering clean, shippable design.'; (4) a dual CTA row (flex-col on mobile, sm:flex-row, centered, gap-3): a primary solid teal-500 pill (h-12, px-7, teal-950 text, teal drop-shadow that lifts on hover) reading 'Start designing free' with a ph:arrow-right-bold icon, and a glassy ghost pill (bg white/10, white/20 border, backdrop blur) reading 'Watch 90-sec demo' with a teal-200 ph:play-circle-fill icon; (5) a small teal-100/75 microcopy line 'No credit card. 50 free generations to start.'; (6) an inline trust signal row (centered, gap-3): an overlapping avatar stack of three teal gradient circles (ring-2 ring teal-950/60) plus a teal-200 '+9k' counter circle, beside five teal-300 ph:star-fill icons and a teal-50/85 label '4.9 from 1,200+ designers'.

A three-up metric-card row pulled up over the bottom of the hero with a negative top margin (-mt-24 / sm:-mt-28) and z-10, centered in max-w-5xl with px-6, grid-cols-1 to sm:grid-cols-3, gap-4/5. Each card: a white rounded-2xl panel with a slate-200/80 border and a soft deep-teal drop shadow (0 28px 64px -30px rgba(2,47,46,0.5)), px-7 py-8, centered text, and a 3px top-accent bar that is a teal-400 to teal-600 gradient spanning the full width. Inside: a huge extrabold ink-colored figure (text 40px to sm:46px, tight tracking, leading-none) above a small uppercase wide-tracked slate-500 caption. The three cards: '2.4M' / 'Designs generated', '9x' / 'Faster idea to UI', '12k+' / 'Teams shipping with Mosaic'. On hover each card lifts (translateY -4px), gains a teal-200 border and a stronger teal shadow.

A centered trust section in max-w-6xl, pt-20 pb-24 on the light canvas. Header: an extrabold ink heading (text 26 to sm:30px, tight tracking) 'Trusted by the people who build the web', and a slate-500 subcopy paragraph (max-w-2xl, ~15px) 'From solo indie hackers to product teams at fast-moving startups, Mosaic is the design layer of the modern stack.'. Below, a bordered white card (rounded-2xl, slate-200/80 border, semi-white fill, px-6/10 py-8) holding a responsive logo grid: grid-cols-2 to sm:grid-cols-3 to lg:grid-cols-6, items centered, gap-x-6 gap-y-7. Each logo is an invented brand lockup: a Phosphor icon (ph:rocket-launch-fill, ph:hexagon-fill, ph:circles-three-fill, ph:lightning-fill, ph:cube-fill, ph:planet-fill) in slate-700 next to a bold tracking-tight name (Liftoff, Hexbase, Trio, Voltic, Cubit, Orbital), each at ~80% opacity that goes full on hover.

special_ui_components.prompt: Layered teal hero gradient (hero-grad): two soft radial teal glows over a vertical linear gradient running #042f2e -> #073735 -> #0e524d -> #1d6b64 -> #3f8d85 -> #a9d8d1 -> #f8fafc, fading the dark hero into the light canvas at the fold
Faint white grid overlay: two 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05) line gradients at 56px, radial-masked from 50% 0% so it fades out toward the edges (pointer-events none)
Glassy eyebrow pill: a rounded-full white/10 chip with a white/15 hairline border and backdrop blur, holding a bold uppercase teal-400 'New' sub-badge and a label

Overlapping white metric cards: white rounded-2xl panels with a teal-400->teal-600 3px top-accent bar, slate-200 border and a soft deep-teal drop shadow, pulled up with negative margin to overlap the hero, lifting + gaining a teal border/shadow on hover

Dual CTA: a solid teal-500 primary pill with teal-950 text and a teal glow drop-shadow that lifts on hover, paired with a glassy white/10 ghost pill (backdrop blur, white/20 border) with a teal play-circle icon
Inline trust signal: an overlapping ring-bordered teal-gradient avatar stack with a '+9k' counter circle, beside a five ph:star-fill teal rating and a '4.9 from 1,200+ designers' label
Gradient logo mark: a rounded-lg linear-gradient(135deg,#14b8a6,#0f766e) badge with a teal shadow holding a white ph:squares-four-fill icon
Six-logo trust strip in a bordered white card: invented brand lockups (Phosphor icon + bold name) in a responsive 2->3->6 col grid at reduced opacity
Sticky blurred nav: a translucent teal-950/70 header with backdrop blur+saturate and a white-10 bottom hairline border

Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: squares-four-fill, arrow-right-bold, play-circle-fill, star-fill, rocket-launch-fill, hexagon-fill, circles-three-fill, lightning-fill, cube-fill, planet-fill

structured.special_notes: Font: Inter only (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900), used for everything with tight tracking; headline and section heads are extrabold (800-900). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette (ink #0f172a, slate2 #334155, slate3 #64748b, teal 50 #f0fdfa / 100 #ccfbf1 / 200 #99f6e4 / 500 #14b8a6 / 600 #0d9488 / 700 #0f766e / 800 #115e59 / 900 #134e4a / 950 #042f2e, canvas #f8fafc). Icons via Iconify (ph:* / Phosphor). html has scroll-behavior:smooth; body background is the canvas #f8fafc with antialiased font smoothing. The signature moves are the deep-teal hero gradient that dissolves into the light canvas at the fold, the radial-masked white grid overlay, and the three white metric cards that overlap the hero edge with their teal top-accent bars; keep the palette a single teal scale, never introduce a second hue.
